name: SNTS at Hard Club
description: For fans of harder sounds, Hard Club hosts a night of driving techno that's sure to keep you dancing until the early hours.
longDescription:
On September 18, 2026, Hard Club presents a night dedicated to driving techno with SNTS. The German DJ and producer is known for his industrial and often dark soundscapes, frequently releasing on his own self-titled label. His sets are characterized by relentless rhythms and a focus on the heavier end of the techno spectrum, making him a fixture in the global underground scene.

Attendees can expect an immersive club experience, with SNTS delivering an extended set designed to maintain high energy throughout the night. The atmosphere will likely be intense and focused on the music, appealing to a dedicated audience of techno enthusiasts. Hard Club, a historic venue located in a former market hall, provides a spacious and robust setting suitable for powerful sound systems and late-night events.

Tickets are available for purchase. Hard Club is situated in the heart of Porto, easily accessible by walking from São Bento train station or by metro to São Bento or Aliados, both within a 5-10 minute walk.
